Maya - CSM: Heads-up: SeaGlass private/VPC onboarding smoke hit three blockers: restricted outbound ports, KMS deny on GenerateDataKey, and audit delivery failing TLS. Recording owners here.
Owen - Solutions Eng: Can someone paste the agent error for the audit forwarder?
Maya - CSM: Agent log: `2026-03-21T09:18:02Z error post https://audit.seaglass.corp: net/http: TLS handshake timeout` when posting batches.
Rina - Infra: Their TGW egress ACLs only allow 443 to specific CIDRs; return traffic uses ephemeral ports. We need either SNAT via a NAT GW they create or add ephemeral outbound (1024-65535) to our forwarder CIDR. They prefer a short change window Sat 01:00-02:00 UTC.
Claire - Customer Ops: SeaGlass agreed to the Sat window and will upload cert chain to the secure vault by Fri 22:00 UTC. They requested cert TTL of 48h retention.
Sam - Security: KMS: current policy blocks `kms:GenerateDataKey` to our role. Minimal snippet sent to Claire DM; I'll drop a short alias-scoped example into runbook. ETA today EOD.
Owen - Solutions Eng: Test plan during change window: (1) infra change, (2) our debug pod runs `curl -v https://audit.seaglass.corp/health` and `openssl s_client -connect audit.seaglass.corp:443` to validate TLS chain, (3) run `aws kms generate-data-key` from our service role to validate encryption. I'll execute steps Sat during the window.
Maya - CSM: Action owners: Rina: confirm SNAT/workaround (ETA Sat 00:30 UTC); Sam: finalize KMS snippet (ETA today EOD); Owen: run tests in window (ETA Sat 01:10 UTC); Claire: confirm cert in vault + retention (ETA Fri 22:00 UTC).
